The '''''Core Conveyor''''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] auxiliary ship in service during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and in use of the [[2nd Airborne Company/Legends|2nd Airborne Company]] ([[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]]). It carried [[Omega Squad]] during their stealth insertion to [[Gaftikar]]. Presumably, it next went to [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]] along with the rest of the 2nd Airborne.
